added_failure_note: The reviewed node declared baseline_suite: none and after_suite: none. It changes no product source and adds no test, so there is no suite arm pair to diff; its two gate logs (before.log, after-final.log) are census measurement runs that each end EXIT=0, not test suites. Zero added failures is the absence of a suite, confirmed by reading the reviewed manifest and the run directory rather than by a green suite.

findings.summary: The method paragraph states that both phases were measured by sib-flush-unaccepted-run.py, but the committed script always writes digest_sensitivity_control and docs_stage_counts and before.json carries neither, so the before arm was taken by an uncommitted script version; its observed_at 2026-11-10T20:10:57Z is 17 minutes before the script first landed in 41bb68f53 at 20:27:45Z, and the baseline of the node's whole delta therefore cannot be reproduced from the repository.

The final verdict paragraph opens with as to both halves of the fence hold, while the table in the same section records sourceless live drafts 3 to 4 and the done_when says that count must not rise; the clause that follows qualifies it to the second pass alone, so the opening claim overstates the drain as a whole and a reader who reads only the verdict takes away a conclusion its own table contradicts.

The documentation gain, which is the node's headline claim, does not reconcile with itself: five hundred of the 529 reviewed names are said to be currently at docs_stage=accepted carrying a drain stamp, five hundred and six are then subtracted from the 3212 accepted to reconstruct the 2706 baseline, and six names are unaccounted for between those two figures, so neither the +506 nor the baseline it implies can be reproduced from the sentence as written.

The granted figure path docs/figures/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-flush-unaccepted is unused and no figure was produced, so a before and after comparison of the census classes, which is decision-relevant data the graphics mandate says to illustrate, ships as table rows only.

item_verdicts.manifest: the manifest reports status complete with the full before and after table, the sourceless rise, the reconstructed docs baseline and USD 58.3597 billed of a USD 60 ceiling, all of which reconcile with after-final.json and its log.
